description: Small high-value SEEK MVP benchmark manifest. It is designed to expose failures and not_covered layers, not to claim 90% success.

cases.goal: Identify visible job cards on SEEK results.
Open a selected card into a detail page without submitting anything.
Read the full detail body before match/apply decision.
Scroll the results list and verify target content changes.
Recognize that Apply opened a third-party ATS surface.
Stop immediately after external ATS plus login_required.
Inventory application form fields before filling.
Block final submit on review page.
Verify no-submit state machine stops at external ATS login blocker.
Recognize a detail page has no Apply entry.
Block modal submit action.
Classify detail read terminal state when bottom is reached.
Classify detail read when repeated captures add no new content.
Classify a non-terminal detail read as still_reading.
Classify detail read as wrong_surface after surface drift.
Classify detail read as blocked_surface on login blocker.
Verify results scroll changes the target list and reveals a new card.
Verify results scroll can terminate at reached_bottom.
Block results scroll after leaving SEEK results surface.
Inventory visible fields before any safe fill.
Block Apply now when it is the final review submit action.
Expose invalid point-grounding fixture evidence instead of counting it as a point-grounding attempt.

metrics.name: point_grounding_success
metrics.root_cause: benchmark case references an execute-step input dry-run trace, not a point-grounding trace with actual point, overlay, coordinate transform, candidate bbox, or gate result evidence
metrics.proposed_fix: replace this fixture with a real recognition-plan or click trace containing candidate bbox, expected bbox, actual point, coordinate transform, gate result, and overlay/debug artifact

cases.goal: Click the SEEK job result card titled Intermediate Software Engineer at Aderant.
Click the Apply button in the right SEEK job detail pane; do not submit.
Scroll the nested SEEK detail container and verify detail content changes.
Scroll results list until new cards appear.
Scroll results list and classify bottom reached as terminal.
Read a long job detail until bottom is reached.
Stop long detail read at max captures and do not mark complete.
Detect Workday external ATS login and safe-stop.
Block Submit application from modal or sticky final review area.
Stop on popup/modal overlay before continuing SEEK card loop.
Click the first job listing in the search results to open its details using recognition-plan/VISTA point evidence.

metrics.name: point_grounding_success
metrics.root_cause: recognition-plan/VISTA selected a point inside the target job-card ROI and the pre-click decision allowed the candidate
metrics.proposed_fix: keep as a positive recognition-plan fixture and add more independent VISTA point samples before making stability claims

cases.goal: Reject a recognition-plan/VISTA point that lands outside the target Senior Agentic Software Engineer card.

metrics.name: point_grounding_success
metrics.point_grounding_failure_class: VISTA point grounding error gated before click
metrics.root_cause: recognition-plan/VISTA point restored to a location far above the target card; pre-click gate rejected because the refined point was outside the candidate bbox and candidate margin was too small
metrics.proposed_fix: preserve as a real miss/gate fixture; future runtime work should improve VISTA point selection and candidate margin evidence without weakening the gate

cases.goal: Fixture-only safe fill planning for low-risk identity, contact, and profile URL fields.
Fixture-only safe fill planning for cover letter textarea with redacted content evidence.
Fixture-only classification for fields that must not be auto-filled without review.
Fixture-only classification for file upload without explicit file selection policy.
Fixture-only guard when final submit is visible after form fields.
Fixture-only stop when a modal or wrong surface blocks reliable form filling.
